benchmarks.interpretation: Primarily exposes CFG construction and lowering for repeated if, while, and match shapes.

benchmarks.interpretation: Exposes semantic checking and lowering for repeated array declarations, indexing, and mutation.

benchmarks.interpretation: Primarily exposes backend lowering and register allocation for repeated functions with many simultaneously live values.
